questions.cardText:
[Chemistry] Which of the following is a chemical reaction?
A. Rusting of iron
B. Boiling water
C. Dissolving sugar in water
Answer: A. A chemical reaction involves the breaking and forming of chemical bonds, resulting in the transformation of substances into new products. Indicators of a chemical reaction include color change, temperature change, gas production, and the formation of a precipitate.
questions.en: What is the term for a process in which chemical bonds are broken and formed so that substances are transformed into new ones, as when iron rusts (unlike boiling water or dissolving sugar)?
questions.de: Wie nennt man einen Vorgang, bei dem chemische Bindungen gebrochen und neu geknüpft werden, sodass Stoffe in neue umgewandelt werden – etwa wenn Eisen rostet (anders als beim Kochen von Wasser oder Lösen von Zucker)?

timeline.labelEn: Lavoisier publishes his Traité élémentaire de chimie, founding the modern chemistry of reactions
timeline.labelDe: Lavoisier veröffentlicht sein Traité élémentaire de chimie, Grundlage der modernen Chemie der Reaktionen

questions.notes: Card asks 'which of the following'; reworked to ask the concept its explanation defines (rusting = oxidation of iron to iron oxide).

questions.cardText:
[Physiology and Anatomy] What is the smallest bone in the human body?
A. Incus
B. Stapes
C. Malleus
Answer: B. The stapes, located in the middle ear, is the smallest bone in the human body.
questions.en: What is the smallest bone in the human body, located in the middle ear?
questions.de: Wie heißt der kleinste Knochen des menschlichen Körpers, der im Mittelohr liegt?

timeline.labelEn: Giovanni Filippo Ingrassia is credited with discovering the stapes at the University of Naples
timeline.labelDe: Giovanni Filippo Ingrassia gilt als Entdecker des Steigbügels an der Universität Neapel
